top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The grassy area on one of the operations playgrounds was found to have a deep step down with the sprinkler system being exposed.

top_violation_types.title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records (26 TAC §747.801(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The admission forms used were outdated. The admission forms do not capture the required minimum standards changes of March 2023.

top_violation_types.title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training (26 TAC §747.801(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregiver has still not completed the required trainings for the last training year.

top_violation_types.title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was a dog in the backyard without vaccinations record.

top_violation_types.title: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian (26 TAC §747.3703(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Primary caregiver is lacking a statement of health from a local veterinarian.

top_violation_types.title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §747.613(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Of the four children's records evaluated, one was behind with required immunizations.

top_violation_types.title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One food allergy plan was not signed by the parent.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information gathered during the investigation, it has been determined that a child was left unattended, the caregiver was not at a physical proximity that allowed visual and/or auditory awareness of the child in care.
